events.text: Built (05ebb2091): Create Paint Atlas prompt gates first paint entry per model — resolution options with real WxH/MB cost, GPU-limit options disabled, recommended level marked; fresh loads drop paint mode and re-arm the prompt. Cart-only, hot reloads.
